# LEADERS Magazine: A More Connected Model of Care – An Interview with Marc D. Miller


marc-miller-leaders_510


**October 2026 —** UHS President and CEO Marc D. Miller has been featured in the October 2026 edition of *LEADERS Magazine* . In this article, Marc discusses UHS’ acquisition of Talkspace and the opportunity to reshape behavioral healthcare by bringing virtual and in-person care together across a full continuum of services.


Marc also shares his perspective on the future of connected, whole-person care and the responsible role technology can play in expanding access and improving the patient experience.


“Ultimately, I think the future of healthcare is about treating the person, not just the condition or the episode of care. When mental and physical health are connected, there is greater opportunity to improve outcomes across both.”


“Bringing together the reach of Talkspace with the depth and scale of UHS, we can fundamentally change how people experience behavioral healthcare – making it easier to access, easier to navigate, easier to stay connected to care, and ultimately more responsive to the way people live their lives.”
